placement.intro_help: This package starts with a short test, so the teachers can place the student at the right level.
placement.intro_1: Answer every question. You can go back and change an answer before you submit.
placement.intro_2: Answers are saved as you go. If the page closes, open it again on this device to continue.
placement.intro_3: The timer starts when you press Start. When time runs out, the test is submitted as it is.
placement.resume_failed: The saved test could not be opened. Start again.
placement.unanswered: Answer every question to submit. Still unanswered:
placement.order_hint: Put the verses in the right order, then confirm it.
placement.confirm_body: All {{n}} questions are answered. After you submit, the answers cannot be changed.
placement.result_help: This is the level recommended from the answers. The teachers confirm the final level when they review the request.
placement.confirm_step_help: Check the details, then send the registration request.
